paragraphs: Strategic Mapping Inc. dates its founding to 2006, when a small team of transportation technologists came together. The page describes the purpose of that work as modernizing transit and fleet operations. Strategic Mapping presents itself as an end to end solution provider offering hardware design, software application and system integration services.

The product headings on the same page list automated stop announcements. Automatic passenger counting is listed as another product. Computer aided dispatch appears in the same list of products. Automatic vehicle location is listed alongside it.
Transit infotainment also appears among the product headings. The page names transit agencies in North America as the recipients of those services.
